text.p: These are the leading stories in the Lebanese press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Israeli soldier killed, eight Lebanese villagers wounded in weekend clashes between Israeli forces and Hizbollah guerrillas in south Lebanon.
- Prime Minister Hariri heads to Spain and Britain next week.
- Parliament on Monday will elect five judges out of 10 Constitutional Council members; other five members will be nominated by government.
- Seven Katyusha rockets slam into northern Israel after day of fighting between Israeli army and Hizbollah guerrillas in south Lebanon.
- Five-nation group monitoring ceasefire in Lebanon will meet on Monday to discuss two Lebanese complaints and one Israeli complaint of breaching April 26, 1996, ceasefire agreement.
- Lebanese-Syrian summit held in Damascus on Saturday.
